notes.title: [Release Notes] 1.0.1H: Request for Overwriting External Patch
notes.content:
This announcement is for users who have applied an external patch.

If you have installed an external patch, the fixes included in Ver. 1.0.1, recently distributed on Steam, will not be applied, and the issue where "staff credits in languages other than Japanese do not play" will not be resolved.

If you are using an external patch, please re-download the latest version of the patch (the file name remains the same) from its distribution source and overwrite the corresponding pfs file.

We appreciate your cooperation and apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: [Release notes] 1.0.1：Bug Fixes
notes.content: Fixed the issue where non-Japanese credits would not play.
